about_the_game:
Musical Meteors is an arcade game mixing retro aesthetics and gameplay with music education. Players learn the layout of the piano by using it to destroy meteors floating across the screen. Each meteor is labelled with a musical note corresponding to a key on the piano. When that key on the piano is pressed, the corresponding meteor explodes, awarding points. Earn enough points to level up and unlock more keys, increasing the difficulty as you play.

IMPORTANT NOTE: This game requires a MIDI keyboard device to be played. User interface elements are interacted with using mouse and keyboard, while the game itself is controlled with a MIDI keyboard. Make sure you have access to a MIDI keyboard and can connect it to your computer before playing. Also ensure that no other programs are running simultaneously that use a MIDI keyboard, as that can interfere with the game's functionality.

name: Musical Meteors
short_description: Musical Meteors is a retro arcade game where your piano is the controller. Destroy meteors by playing the piano to rack up score and level up. Break as many meteors as you can within the time limit to achieve high scores and build your mastery over the piano.
